name: roy-mission-control
description: A captain runs a mission from design to tested code end to end, pausing only when the user has a decision to make, and reports progress after every stage.

interface.shortDescription: Design to tested code, end to end, with a progress report at every step.
interface.longDescription: Eleven numbered agents take a design through product definition, release scope, phases, plans, code, review, and tests. The captain pauses only for decisions and keeps a progress file showing what is done, in progress, and left.
defaultPrompt: Start a mission from my design.
